services.name: Day Camp
services.desc: For 15 years, Woodcrest Retreat has been voted a winner for “Best Day Camp” in Lancaster Newspaper Reader’s Choice Awards! Parents! Have you searched tirelessly for a fun and engaging place for your child(ren) to spend a week or more of their summer? Woodcrest is a safe place where you can confidently leave your child each morning knowing they are valued, loved, and cared for by staff. The Discovery program is for ages 6-11 while the Trekkers program is for ages 12-14. Both provide a place to learn and grow here on the Ephrata Mountain. services.name: RV campground
services.desc: Enjoy a refreshing time away from the hustle and bustle of life, in our beautiful wooded campground. All Woodcrest’s campground sites have water and electric. Our “B” sites also contain sewer hookups. Amenities include a dumping station, picnic tables, fire rings, bath house, playground and a camp store. Between Memorial Day and Labor Day there is a two night minimum on weekends (three nights for holiday weekends). Circle Pavilion Area: Groups will enjoy this circle of 14 campsites surrounding the Circle Pavilion.
